headline: Pixel 11 specs and price leak with no surprises
summary: Android Headlines leaked full Pixel 11 specs and pricing. The details align with previous rumors. The Pixel 11 is expected to start at $899 with 256GB storage.

headline: Angela Nissel faces down grief with a laugh
summary: Angela Nissel's new memoir, "Good Grief, Pass the Bread, Mom Is Dead," explores grief. The book delivers an emotional tale about caring for a terminally ill parent. Nissel uses gallows humor to navigate tough times.

headline: Is this Billboard Hot 100 hit AI slop?
summary: Fenix Flexin's track "Rubberz" reached number 58 on the Billboard Hot 100. Questions are being raised about the song's origins. Many speculate the hit was largely AI-generated.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day leak racks up millions of views
summary: A bootleg of "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" was leaked on X. It accumulated over 5.9 million views and 143,000 likes. Disney is now actively removing reposts of the film.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Beats Avengers: Endgame Record to Claim Biggest Domestic Opening Day of All Time
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day shattered box office records. It claimed the biggest domestic opening day ever. The film grossed an astounding $168 million.

headline: Game of Thrones: The Mad King Reveals Full Stage Cast and First Portrait
summary: The full stage cast for "Game of Thrones: The Mad King" has been revealed. A first official cast photo was released. It features King Aerys II, Rhaegar Targaryen, and Young Ned Stark.

headline: Vincent Pastore, The Sopranos Actor, Dies at 80
summary: Vincent Pastore, known for "The Sopranos," passed away at 80. He famously played Salvatore Bonpensiero. Pastore was a key actor in the groundbreaking TV series.

headline: Elden Ring Players Are Hoping for Godwyn DLC After FromSoftware Shares Cryptic Social Media Post
summary: FromSoftware posted a cryptic social media message. Fans are speculating it hints at new Elden Ring DLC. Players hope for a Godwyn-focused expansion.

headline: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
summary: US President Trump cancelled planned strikes on Iran. Cancellation is contingent on a deal being made 'rapidly.' Iran and other countries reportedly requested the hold-off.

headline: How a shadowy gang is recruiting teenage hitmen to kill across Europe
summary: The "Foxtrot Network" gang is recruiting teenage hitmen. They are linked to approximately 35 murders across Europe. The network employs "violence-as-a-service" tactics.

headline: Three killed after bomb detonated at Moscow restaurant, state media say
summary: A bomb detonated at a Moscow restaurant, killing three people. A woman attempted to enter the restaurant with explosives. She was stopped by a security guard before detonation.

headline: After a bruising 24 hours, what next for Fifa and under-pressure Infantino?
summary: Pressure is building on Fifa President Gianni Infantino. This follows the implosion of a controversial World Cup investment plan. Questions are being raised about his future as president.
